title: Rains, cloudy skies to prevail over parts of PH on Nov. 12

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The northeast monsoon, or amihan, may bring cloudy skies with rains over Northern and Central Luzon, while the easterlies may continue to affect the rest of the country on Thursday, Nov. 12, the state weather bureau said.
